title: Process map
description: Every stage from application to competition result: who does what, and how many applications and projects are in each stage. Click a stage to open its list.

scopeNote.admin: Coordinator view: all applications and projects.
scopeNote.team: Team view: you only see where your own project and application are.
scopeNote.mentor: Mentor view: only the projects assigned to you are counted.
scopeNote.jury: Jury view: projects assigned to you and applications in the selection stage.

present.label: Presentation mode
present.subtitle: Process, roles and KPI funnel from application to finalists

diagramCard.title: Live workflow diagram
diagramCard.hint: Role lanes, decision points, waitlist and rejection paths. Numbers are live; click a stage.

list.title: Items in the stage
list.pickHint: Click a stage in the diagram or the table to see its list.
list.hiddenHint: The items in this stage are outside your visibility.

table.title: Stage table
table.hint: Text version of the diagram: order, responsible roles and live count.

stepper.title: Process stage
stepper.hintProject: Passed, current and upcoming stages; the date of every transition and the responsible role.
stepper.hintApplication: Where the application is in the process, and its transition history.
stepper.finished: The process has been completed successfully.
stepper.waiting: On the waitlist: the coordinator will update the decision if a place opens up.
stepper.stopped: The process stopped on this path (rejected / not selected).
stepper.last: This is the last stage of the process.

move.title: Change stage
move.systemHint: Moving to a system stage also updates the bound status (stage, result, decision); a custom stage only changes the place in the process.
move.noteHint: Why is it changing? The note is written to the audit log and the team is notified.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.noteRequired: A note is required (at least 5 characters; 10 for decision stages).
errors.sameStage: The item is already in this stage.
errors.inactive: Items cannot be moved to an inactive stage.
errors.locked: The project workspace exists: the application decision is locked, continue on the project.
errors.useWorkspace: This stage is reached only with the “Create project workspace” button.

admin.title: Process stages
admin.description: Add stages, rename them and edit descriptions in three languages, reorder or deactivate them. The process map and steppers update immediately.
admin.rules: System stages are bound to existing statuses and filled automatically: they cannot be deleted or deactivated, but their name, description, responsible roles and order can change. Custom stages are reached only by a manual move. Every change is written to the audit log.

scopeHint.APPLICATION: Selection period: from application to opening the project workspace.
scopeHint.PROJECT: Incubation: from validation to the competition result.

admin.addHint: A custom stage is inserted where you choose. Items are moved into it manually only.
admin.systemHint: System stage: name, description and responsible roles can change; its kind is fixed.
admin.customHint: Custom stage: every field can change.

fields.fallbackHint: If empty, the AZ name is shown.
fields.kindHint: Waiting and rejected kinds are drawn as side paths branching from the previous stage's decision point.
fields.kindLocked: The kind of a system stage does not change.
fields.rolesHint: The first selected role is the main lane in the diagram.

admin.hasItemsHint: This stage holds {count} items. Move them to another active stage first.
admin.deactivateHint: The stage is removed from the diagram and pickers; history is kept. You can activate it again later.
admin.deleteHint: The stage is deleted permanently; it stays in the transition history as “deleted stage”.
admin.moveToHint: Every move is written to the history and the audit log.

errors.system: A system stage cannot be deleted or deactivated.
errors.hasItems: The stage holds items: choose where to move them.
errors.target: Choose another active stage of the same scope.
